messages:
sarah: FYI — I'm proposing we change the Python SDK default to emit the routing header and a lightweight cost-center telemetry field for new Hosted customers. planning a feature flag so we can roll out gradually. thoughts?

ajay: Does this affect existing customers or only new signups?

sarah: Only new signups by default, but we'll provide an opt-in env var for anyone who wants it earlier. goal is better console attribution and cost dashboards without extra server-side bookkeeping.

kate: We should be careful — changing header shapes can break internal proxies. Can the SDK emit both legacy and v2 formats for a transition window?

sarah: yep thinking dual emission for 30 days then switch off legacy. server will accept either but console mapping prefers v2 keys.

tom: Also: what about PII risk? cost-center sometimes contains business-sensitive strings. we should sample and hash client-side.

sarah: agree. plan is to send a small tokenized cc id (e.g., cc-1234) not free-text. default sampling = 1% (configurable).

ajay: sample config snippet?

sarah: ```python
# new default behavior (rough sketch)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.generate("hello", headers={
  "x-redwood-route": "tier:low",  # auto-added by SDK if not supplied
  "x-redwood-cost-center": "cc-1234",  # tokenized id, sampled
})
```

kate: That looks OK. We should expose env var override name and a runtime flag in the SDK: REDWOOD_PY_ROUTE_TELEMETRY=on/off and a sampling env REDWOOD_PY_ROUTE_TELEMETRY_SAMPLING=0.01

sarah: adding that to plan. Also adding CLI opt and runtime config in client constructor.

infra-team-bot: :eyes: I'll need the server acceptance schema. Please include both headers we plan to emit: `x-redwood-route-v2`, `x-redwood-route` (legacy) and `x-redwood-cost-token`.

sarah: noted. server schema PR will land tomorrow — will ping @devex when ready.

ajay: Rollout strategy idea: canary 1% of new signups for two weeks, 10% next week, then 100% after monitoring. console dashboards must show attribution coverage metric before full rollout.

sarah: yes — will add rollout plan to the ticket. also plan to ship an opt-out toggle in console for enterprise accounts.

kate: Docs + migration note for integrators. Small SDK patch release (minor semver) but we should call out header dual-emission and sampling.

sarah: propose we land as 0.61.0 with clear changelog and toggle.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout: 2024-08-12 03:00 UTC -> canary group: new-hosted-signups-1pct

sarah: thanks — I'll follow up with a short test matrix and a quick verification checklist for the console team. :thumbsup:
